title: 作品与设计记录
intro: 从五官与眉形轮廓，看到线条的结构、疏密和自然毛流。这里保留真实模特与顾客作品；照片中的设计、妆容和拍摄阶段各不相同，不是对其他人的效果承诺。
intro_en: From facial features and brow contours to stroke structure, density and natural hair flow. These are real model and client work records. Designs, makeup and recording stages vary; another person’s photograph is not a promise of your result.
